in_sanskrit.name: शर्जा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Sharja is derived from the Sanskrit word शर्ज (sharj), which means sharp or piercing. This name is not commonly used in Hindu traditions and may be a rare or unique name.

in_hindi.name: शर्जा
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Sharja in Hindi is derived from the words शर्ज (sharj) and सीखा (sikhā). The former means sharp or piercing, while the latter means to learn or teach. Together, the name Sharja could be interpreted as one who pierces or sharpens knowledge or understanding.

in_tamil.name: சர்ஜா
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Sharja can be interpreted as one who is born sharp or one who has a sharp nature. The name is derived from the Tamil words சர் (char) which means sharp and ஜா (jā) which means born.

in_telugu.name: శర్జా
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Sharja can be interpreted as one who is born sharp or one who has a sharp nature. The name is derived from the Telugu words శర్ (shar) which means sharp and జా (jā) which means born.
